title: Docker Health Check Configuration — Companion Files
title_es: Configuración de Docker Health Check — Archivos complementarios
description: Runnable HEALTHCHECK examples: Dockerfiles for Node and Python, simple/multi-step/logged health check scripts, a Docker Compose stack with depends_on service_healthy, a production override, a heartbeat-based worker check, and a Spring Boot health endpoint.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de HEALTHCHECK: Dockerfiles para Node y Python, scripts de health check simple/de varios pasos/con logging, un stack de Docker Compose con depends_on service_healthy, un override de producción, un check de worker basado en heartbeat y un endpoint de health de Spring Boot.
